# Traceability chain for %CAR+ (CAR expression, % of CD3+ by flow, test code FC-CAR)

## 1. Definition and specification
- PPQ-001 criterion #8 is a CQA: CAR expression (% CAR+ of CD3+) ≥ 20 % of CD3+.
- Related CQA #9 is vector copy number (VCN) per CAR+ cell, ≤ 5.0. It is linked to %CAR+ through MOI (FM-05).
- The same ≥ 20 % limit is applied as spec_lo on FC-CAR in the QC results. In the engineering runs it is reported as RELEASE-INFO.

## 2. Process parameters that drive it
- **MOI (CPP 1, 4.0–6.0 TU/cell)** is the strongest driver.
  - DOE-MOI-01/02/03 each ran MOI 2.5, 5, 10 and 15. Mean %CAR+ was about 22 %, 39 %, 65 % and 76 %, and VCN rose from about 1.6 to about 4.8.
  - Vector volume = MOI × cells / CoA functional titer, so the titer drives the *actual* MOI.
- **Vector functional titer and storage** is the other main driver (FM-07). The titer used in the calculation is the CoA value, not the post-storage value.
- **Time from activation to transduction (CPP 5, 20–30 h)** is a weaker driver. Among the 29 non-LV25-118 batches at MOI 5, its correlation with %CAR+ is about +0.34.
- Culture duration (CPP 4, day 7–9) and the harvest wash (FM-11/FM-12) affect the CAR+ *viable cell dose*, not %CAR+ itself. PPQ batches all harvested on day 8.

## 3. Risks that threaten it (RA-PFMEA-001 v2.0)

| Risk | Failure mode | Impact | Class / RPN |
|---|---|---|---|
| FM-06 | MOI below target (titer over-estimated, vector degraded) | %CAR+, Potency | HIGH / 128 |
| FM-07 | Vector held above -70 °C (ULT failure) | Transduction efficiency, VCN | HIGH / 96 |
| FM-08 | Transduction outside 20–30 h | TE | MEDIUM / 54 |
| FM-15 | OOS not flagged | %CAR+ among others | HIGH / 80 |
| FM-05 | MOI above target | VCN | HIGH / 108 |
| FM-11 | Culture duration outside day 7–9 | CAR+ viable cell dose | LOW |
| FM-12 | Wash cell loss | CAR+ viable cell dose | MEDIUM |

- FM-05 relates to %CAR+ only indirectly, through the VCN link.
- FM-07 and FM-08 list the effect as transduction efficiency (TE) rather than %CAR+. I treated TE as equivalent to %CAR+, which is my interpretation.
- No pFMEA item has an assurance approach recorded.

## 4. Controls and test evidence (with gaps)
- **FM-06 / FM-05 (MOI)**
  - URS-EBR-007 (vector-volume calculation) maps to CS-EBR-02 and is verified by TC-OQ-EBR-04. That test was executed as TX-0083, PASS on 2026-03-17.
  - SOP-MFG-104 is the procedural control.
  - **GAP:** URS-EBR-009 (reject MOI outside 4.0–6.0) and CS-EBR-03 (hard-stop config) have **no test case**. They are also linked to FM-05 only, not FM-06.
- **FM-07 (vector storage)**
  - URS-ULT-001 is verified by TC-OQ-ULT-01 and TC-PQ-ULT-01. URS-ULT-002 is verified by TC-OQ-ULT-02. Executions TX-0037/38/39/40/43/44 passed. Re-executions TX-0091/92 passed after the compressor change (CC-26-014).
  - SOP-MAT-401 is the procedural control.
  - **GAP:** URS-EMS-014 (escalation within 15 min) has **no direct test case**. CS-EMS-03 was verified only by TC-OQ-EMS-04 (TX-0070, 2026-01-20).
  - CC-26-011 then rebuilt the escalation groups on 2026-03-12/16 as MINOR with "no re-testing required". So the test predates the configuration it verifies.
  - This control did not work in practice. The FRZ-80-02 alarm (EV-26-0009) started at 03:20 on 2026-04-20 and was acknowledged at 14:40, about 11 h later, by warehouse staff.
- **FM-08 and FM-11:** these have only a batch-record check and an SOP (SOP-MFG-104 / SOP-MFG-106). They have no spec item or test case.
- **FM-12:** URS-LOVO-001 (≥ 85 % recovery) is verified by TC-PQ-LOVO-01 (TX-0061, PASS). PPQ wash recovery was 88–94 %.
- **FM-15 (OOS flagging)**
  - CS-LIMS-01 is verified by TC-OQ-LIMS-03 (TX-0075, PASS).
  - **GAP:** URS-LIMS-002 and URS-LIMS-003 have no direct test case.

## 5. How it is measured and validated
- Method AM-FC-CAR (flow cytometry, validated range 5–90 % of CD3+, status VALIDATED).
- Validation protocol AMV-FC-CAR-01 (report approved 2026-03-02). Test case TC-AMV-CAR-01 was executed as TX-0086, PASS.
- The 20 % limit lies inside the validated range.
- TC-AMV-CAR-01 has no formal trace link to a spec item, although the method link is clear.

## 6. PPQ performance (PPQ-001, execution complete, report pending)
- FC-CAR results (% of CD3+):

| Batch | %CAR+ |
|---|---|
| PPQ26-01 | 44.6 |
| PPQ26-02 | 39.2 |
| PPQ26-03 | 36.1 |
| PPQ26-04 | 38.9 |
| PPQ26-05 | 37.3 |

- All five passed (mean 39.2, range 36.1–44.6). VCN was 1.79–2.39, also passing.
- All CPPs were in range: MOI 5.0, 21.9–23.7 h to transduction, seeding density 0.47–0.54.
- PPQ used vector lots LV26-007 and LV26-021, both stored in FRZ-80-01.

## 7. Related deviation and what connects it
- **DEV-26-027** (OPEN, MINOR, atypical result) covers low %CAR+ in ENG26-01 and ENG26-02.
  - It is linked to batches ENG26-01 and ENG26-02 and to CAPA-26-016, which evaluates a minimum CD3 % at apheresis receipt (OPEN, due 2026-09-30).
  - The stated root cause is donor variability. **The data does not support this.**
- **The data points to vector lot LV25-118 and the FRZ-80-02 excursion (DEV-26-021, CAPA-26-008, CC-26-014, EV-26-0009).**
  - LV25-118 was stored in FRZ-80-02. The historian shows the chamber rising above -70 °C from 04:00 on 2026-04-20 and reaching about -36 °C by the 15:30 relocation. The relocation put the contents in FRZ-80-01.
  - DEV-26-021 closed it as low risk with "no lots placed on hold".
  - Same lot, same MOI 5.0 (the first four values are batches PD26-014 to PD26-023 before the excursion, the last four are PD26-024 to PD26-027 after it):
    - Before the excursion, %CAR+ was 34.5–41.3.
    - After it, %CAR+ was 14.9–17.3.
  - The ENG runs sit at 11.9–19.8 on the same lot.
  - Apheresis CD3 % does not explain the drop. The post-excursion batches ranged 50.9–65.3 %, comparable to PPQ batches that gave about 37–45 %.
  - LV26-007 and LV26-021 give normal results.
- **Further gaps**
  - ENG26-03 (13.9 %) is also below 20 % but is not covered by DEV-26-027.
  - Four post-excursion development batches (PD26-024 to PD26-027, 14.9–17.3 %) have no deviation.
- **CC-26-022** (in impact assessment) proposes raising target MOI from 5 to 8 TU/cell, based on DOE-MOI-02/03.
  - It is outside the validated CPP range of 4.0–6.0 and the EBR hard stop (URS-EBR-009 / CS-EBR-03).
  - Its impact assessment lists only SOP-MFG-104. It does not cover PPQ-001, RA-PFMEA-001, the EBR configuration or the VCN limit. This is the same untested control noted in section 4.

## Link summary
The chain runs: MOI / vector titer / CPP 5 → FM-06, FM-07, FM-08 → URS-EBR-007 / URS-ULT-001/002 / URS-EMS-014 → TC-OQ-EBR-04 / TC-OQ-ULT-01/02 / TC-PQ-ULT-01 → TX-0083, TX-0037 to TX-0044, TX-0091/92. The measurement path is AM-FC-CAR → AMV-FC-CAR-01 → TX-0086. Both feed PPQ-001 criterion 8 → PPQ26-01 to 05. The deviation path is DEV-26-027 → ENG26-01 and ENG26-02 → CAPA-26-016. The overlooked link is FRZ-80-02 → DEV-26-021 → CAPA-26-008 / CC-26-014 → lot LV25-118 → ENG26-01/02/03. CC-26-011 and EV-26-0009 sit behind the escalation gap.

# Traceability chain for %CAR+ (CAR expression, % of CD3+ by flow, test code FC-CAR)

## 1. Definition and specification
- PPQ-001 criterion #8 is a CQA: CAR expression (% CAR+ of CD3+) ≥ 20 % of CD3+.
- Related CQA #9 is vector copy number (VCN) per CAR+ cell, ≤ 5.0. It is linked to %CAR+ through MOI (FM-05).
- The same ≥ 20 % limit is applied as spec_lo on FC-CAR in the QC results. In the engineering runs it is reported as RELEASE-INFO.

## 2. Process parameters that drive it
- **MOI (CPP 1, 4.0–6.0 TU/cell)** is the strongest driver.
  - DOE-MOI-01/02/03 each ran MOI 2.5, 5, 10 and 15. Mean %CAR+ was about 22 %, 39 %, 65 % and 76 %, and VCN rose from about 1.6 to about 4.8.
  - Vector volume = MOI × cells / CoA functional titer, so the titer drives the *actual* MOI.
- **Vector functional titer and storage** is the other main driver (FM-07). The titer used in the calculation is the CoA value, not the post-storage value.
- **Time from activation to transduction (CPP 5, 20–30 h)** is a weaker driver. Among the 29 non-LV25-118 batches at MOI 5, its correlation with %CAR+ is about +0.34.
- Culture duration (CPP 4, day 7–9) and the harvest wash (FM-11/FM-12) affect the CAR+ *viable cell dose*, not %CAR+ itself. PPQ batches all harvested on day 8.

## 3. Risks that threaten it (RA-PFMEA-001 v2.0)

| Risk | Failure mode | Impact | Class / RPN |
|---|---|---|---|
| FM-06 | MOI below target (titer over-estimated, vector degraded) | %CAR+, Potency | HIGH / 128 |
| FM-07 | Vector held above -70 °C (ULT failure) | Transduction efficiency, VCN | HIGH / 96 |
| FM-08 | Transduction outside 20–30 h | TE | MEDIUM / 54 |
| FM-15 | OOS not flagged | %CAR+ among others | HIGH / 80 |
| FM-05 | MOI above target | VCN | HIGH / 108 |
| FM-11 | Culture duration outside day 7–9 | CAR+ viable cell dose | LOW |
| FM-12 | Wash cell loss | CAR+ viable cell dose | MEDIUM |

- FM-05 relates to %CAR+ only indirectly, through the VCN link.
- FM-07 and FM-08 list the effect as transduction efficiency (TE) rather than %CAR+. I treated TE as equivalent to %CAR+, which is my interpretation.
- No pFMEA item has an assurance approach recorded.

## 4. Controls and test evidence (with gaps)
- **FM-06 / FM-05 (MOI)**
  - URS-EBR-007 (vector-volume calculation) maps to CS-EBR-02 and is verified by TC-OQ-EBR-04. That test was executed as TX-0083, PASS on 2026-03-17.
  - SOP-MFG-104 is the procedural control.
  - **GAP:** URS-EBR-009 (reject MOI outside 4.0–6.0) and CS-EBR-03 (hard-stop config) have **no test case**. They are also linked to FM-05 only, not FM-06.
- **FM-07 (vector storage)**
  - URS-ULT-001 is verified by TC-OQ-ULT-01 and TC-PQ-ULT-01. URS-ULT-002 is verified by TC-OQ-ULT-02. Executions TX-0037/38/39/40/43/44 passed. Re-executions TX-0091/92 passed after the compressor change (CC-26-014).
  - SOP-MAT-401 is the procedural control.
  - **GAP:** URS-EMS-014 (escalation within 15 min) has **no direct test case**. CS-EMS-03 was verified only by TC-OQ-EMS-04 (TX-0070, 2026-01-20).
  - CC-26-011 then rebuilt the escalation groups on 2026-03-12/16 as MINOR with "no re-testing required". So the test predates the configuration it verifies.
  - This control did not work in practice. The FRZ-80-02 alarm (EV-26-0009) started at 03:20 on 2026-04-20 and was acknowledged at 14:40, about 11 h later, by warehouse staff.
- **FM-08 and FM-11:** these have only a batch-record check and an SOP (SOP-MFG-104 / SOP-MFG-106). They have no spec item or test case.
- **FM-12:** URS-LOVO-001 (≥ 85 % recovery) is verified by TC-PQ-LOVO-01 (TX-0061, PASS). PPQ wash recovery was 88–94 %.
- **FM-15 (OOS flagging)**
  - CS-LIMS-01 is verified by TC-OQ-LIMS-03 (TX-0075, PASS).
  - **GAP:** URS-LIMS-002 and URS-LIMS-003 have no direct test case.

## 5. How it is measured and validated
- Method AM-FC-CAR (flow cytometry, validated range 5–90 % of CD3+, status VALIDATED).
- Validation protocol AMV-FC-CAR-01 (report approved 2026-03-02). Test case TC-AMV-CAR-01 was executed as TX-0086, PASS.
- The 20 % limit lies inside the validated range.
- TC-AMV-CAR-01 has no formal trace link to a spec item, although the method link is clear.

## 6. PPQ performance (PPQ-001, execution complete, report pending)
- FC-CAR results (% of CD3+):

| Batch | %CAR+ |
|---|---|
| PPQ26-01 | 44.6 |
| PPQ26-02 | 39.2 |
| PPQ26-03 | 36.1 |
| PPQ26-04 | 38.9 |
| PPQ26-05 | 37.3 |

- All five passed (mean 39.2, range 36.1–44.6). VCN was 1.79–2.39, also passing.
- All CPPs were in range: MOI 5.0, 21.9–23.7 h to transduction, seeding density 0.47–0.54.
- PPQ used vector lots LV26-007 and LV26-021, both stored in FRZ-80-01.

## 7. Related deviation and what connects it
- **DEV-26-027** (OPEN, MINOR, atypical result) covers low %CAR+ in ENG26-01 and ENG26-02.
  - It is linked to batches ENG26-01 and ENG26-02 and to CAPA-26-016, which evaluates a minimum CD3 % at apheresis receipt (OPEN, due 2026-09-30).
  - The stated root cause is donor variability. **The data does not support this.**
- **The data points to vector lot LV25-118 and the FRZ-80-02 excursion (DEV-26-021, CAPA-26-008, CC-26-014, EV-26-0009).**
  - LV25-118 was stored in FRZ-80-02. The historian shows the chamber rising above -70 °C from 04:00 on 2026-04-20 and reaching about -36 °C by the 15:30 relocation. The relocation put the contents in FRZ-80-01.
  - DEV-26-021 closed it as low risk with "no lots placed on hold".
  - Same lot, same MOI 5.0 (the first four values are batches PD26-014 to PD26-023 before the excursion, the last four are PD26-024 to PD26-027 after it):
    - Before the excursion, %CAR+ was 34.5–41.3.
    - After it, %CAR+ was 14.9–17.3.
  - The ENG runs sit at 11.9–19.8 on the same lot.
  - Apheresis CD3 % does not explain the drop. The post-excursion batches ranged 50.9–65.3 %, comparable to PPQ batches that gave about 37–45 %.
  - LV26-007 and LV26-021 give normal results.
- **Further gaps**
  - ENG26-03 (13.9 %) is also below 20 % but is not covered by DEV-26-027.
  - Four post-excursion development batches (PD26-024 to PD26-027, 14.9–17.3 %) have no deviation.
- **CC-26-022** (in impact assessment) proposes raising target MOI from 5 to 8 TU/cell, based on DOE-MOI-02/03.
  - It is outside the validated CPP range of 4.0–6.0 and the EBR hard stop (URS-EBR-009 / CS-EBR-03).
  - Its impact assessment lists only SOP-MFG-104. It does not cover PPQ-001, RA-PFMEA-001, the EBR configuration or the VCN limit. This is the same untested control noted in section 4.

## Link summary
The chain runs: MOI / vector titer / CPP 5 → FM-06, FM-07, FM-08 → URS-EBR-007 / URS-ULT-001/002 / URS-EMS-014 → TC-OQ-EBR-04 / TC-OQ-ULT-01/02 / TC-PQ-ULT-01 → TX-0083, TX-0037 to TX-0044, TX-0091/92. The measurement path is AM-FC-CAR → AMV-FC-CAR-01 → TX-0086. Both feed PPQ-001 criterion 8 → PPQ26-01 to 05. The deviation path is DEV-26-027 → ENG26-01 and ENG26-02 → CAPA-26-016. The overlooked link is FRZ-80-02 → DEV-26-021 → CAPA-26-008 / CC-26-014 → lot LV25-118 → ENG26-01/02/03. CC-26-011 and EV-26-0009 sit behind the escalation gap.
